transcript_only_text:
How do you increase the likelihood that
people comply with what you ask them to do at scale? Influence comes from four
things. Do you have the stuff they want? Money is a scarce resource. If you have
money, you have status. Power is, "Hey, next time you do see XYZ, do this
instead and good thing happens." Once I follow a prescription and a good thing
occurs, it increases the likelihood that when that person makes a request or
makes a command, I'm going to comply with that. I have credibility, which is
do I have proof in the world that what I have said is true, which is I followed
my own directions and a good thing happened. Are you like me?
Do you look like me? Do you share the same values as me? Do you talk the same
way? Is there some sort of likeness? That's what influence is.
